$comment: Per-declaration assurance for Broiler.Plate. Product projects only: the Broiler.Plate.Windows.Tests suite under src/tests and the eng/ and scripts/ tooling are not listed, so they are not covered. The Win32 clipboard comes from the Broiler.Hosting.Windows package and is assured there, not here. No source here is third-party-derived and nothing is generated, so there are no excludes and no spdxOverrides.
regenerateCommand: dotnet run --project Broiler.Code/src/Broiler.Code.Review.Cli -c Release -- assurance generate --root Broiler.Plate
